acceptance_criteria.statement: A fixture project completes all sixteen required local-real journey behaviors with actual implementation, tests, isolated Git worktrees, independent verification, governed integration, Jira reconciliation, restart/worker loss, HUMAN_REQUIRED partial continuation, Command Center truth, and automatic next selection.

definition_of_done: Real source and tests change in isolated Git worktrees.
Independent verification and governed integration pass.
Restart, worker loss, incident, unaffected continuation, UI truth, and next selection are observed.
description: Build and run the local-real product-level golden journey. Component calls executed sequentially, mocked remote-only behavior, or generated evidence are insufficient by themselves.
objective: Prove the complete local-real autonomous project journey
observability_impact: Preserves evidence for every material operation and exposes truthful live journey state.
rationale: This is the first product-level proof rather than another component simulation.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Use disposable fixture targets and preserve failed-run evidence and checkpoints.
security_impact: Runs isolated, capability-scoped fixtures with no production credentials.
title: Prove the complete local-real autonomous project journey
